ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with macro-level pixel distribution exceeding 90% dark pixels; high-intensity (white) pixels are confined to localized circular clusters creating high local contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Multiple discrete, high-contrast white circular rosettes (10-25 pixel diameter) semi-randomly distributed across both lobes; no large-scale contiguous geometric pigment bands or mottling are detected.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge boundary characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire span from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the trailing edge leading to distinctly upturned and slightly tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial constellation of circular white pixel rings (scars) clustered throughout the ventral surface, with visible concentrations in the mid-sections of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of protruding, high-intensity calcified structures (barnacles) on the distal tips and along sections of the trailing edge, altering the linear silhouette of the fluke.
